title: L1-planning-backlog-prioritizer-evaluator Output
description: Full AgentOutput envelope. content.items.verification_results holds one independently-recomputed entry per feature the generator scored (structural fields stay full: ids, scores, booleans). content.items.fixes_applied lists any correction made to items and/or the artifact. content.verdict is the overall pass/fail call. If a fix touched the document itself, content.artifacts[0] carries the SAME artifact id and storage location as the generator's, re-uploaded with corrected content — never a new id.

workflow_execution_id.description: MUST match the workflow_execution_id of the generator_output being evaluated.

verification_results.description: One entry per feature_id present in generator_output.content.items.prioritized_features.

guardrail_rechecks.description: Independent re-check of each BLOCKER-relevant guardrail the generator owns — never a copy of the generator's own pass/fail claim.

final_decision.description: 'fixed_and_approved' MUST NOT be reported while the artifact still holds pre-fix text — see Don'ts.

hallucination_score.description: Lower is better — rate of unsupported/invented values found.

consistency_score.description: Rate of rank orders that correctly respect the dependency graph.

artifacts.description: Present ONLY if a fix touched the document. Same artifact id and storage.location as the generator's — re-uploaded, not a new artifact.

source_reference.description: e.g. 'features.json' or 'value-scoring-sheet.xlsx' — the ORIGINAL source, re-checked independently, not the generator's citation copied verbatim.

recomputed_priority_score.description: Independently recomputed from features/value_scoring_inputs using the stated scoring_method formula.

recomputed_dependency_unblocking_score.description: Independently recomputed by walking dependency_graph directly, not read from generator_output.

rank_respects_dependency_graph.description: False if this feature outranks a feature that blocks it, with no documented trade-off in its summary.

duplicate_flag_verified.description: Present only when adjacent_backlog_check=true; result of an independent tool-L1-jira-fetch-issue call, not the generator's stored flag.

score_match.description: True if recomputed values match the generator's claims within rounding tolerance AND rank_respects_dependency_graph is true.

summary.description: Distilled finding. Full reasoning is in execution_summary or the fix entry, never restated here.

generator_value.description: Stringified original value for a uniform diff view.

document_updated.description: True if this field also appears in prioritized-backlog.md and was corrected there at the same location.

id.description: MUST equal the generator's artifact id — this is a re-upload, not a new artifact.

location.description: MUST equal the generator's storage.location — same {workflow_execution_id}/prioritized-backlog.md path.
